correctness.rationale: Pell strong divisibility gives pairwise gcds 5,29 and 2 in stated congruence cases; 5c=2a+29b gives a five-residue disjoint decomposition for n multiple of 3, producing closed Hilbert and gap counts. Separate direct recurrence handles n=3,4,5. For n>=6 nonredundancy and Herzog–Watanabe symmetry criterion exclude each candidate gcd pair when 3∤n; formulas correctly specialize at the boundary.

evidence: Fel/Herzog–Watanabe is a broad necessary-and-sufficient structural gluing criterion.
The Pell offset-(3,5) proof additionally establishes minimal generators, gcd periodicities, relation 5c=2a+29b and index exclusion.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The general semigroup criterion does not mechanically supply the exact Pell index classification or closed formula without this nontrivial arithmetic specialization; related Resultary Pell (3,4) has a different generator.

evidence: General 3-generated symmetric semigroup criterion requires a nontrivial gcd-pair gluing.
Here gcd(a,b)=5 for 3|n, gcd(a,c)=29 for 5|n, gcd(b,c)=2 for odd n and all remaining gluing possibilities are ruled out.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Earlier criterion underlies the proof but requires Pell-specific divisibility and inequalities; Komatsu–Mu does not cover the same offsets. No direct stronger implication identified in inspected texts.

evidence: Komatsu–Mu 2023 studies Pell triples P_i(u),P_(i+2)(u),P_(i+k)(u), not simultaneous offsets 3 and 5.
Fel 2008 uses symmetric three-generator criterion for Fibonacci/Lucas triples; a general criterion is prior mathematics.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The specific Pell arithmetic condition n divisible by 3 or n=4,5, with F/Hilbert formulas, was not found as an equivalent statement in the inspected primary texts.

evidence: No exact (3,5)-offset semigroup invariant table found in searched published records.
The formulas cover an infinite indexed family rather than entries in a finite numerical semigroup table.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: A small Apéry computation corroborates but does not create the theorem; neither a table of initial Pell values nor offset-(3,4) semigroup data implies the all-index classification.

originality.rationale: Fel/Herzog gives the known abstract 3-generated semigroup gluing criterion and treats Fibonacci/Lucas, while Komatsu–Mu 2023 Pell family has a generator at offset two. Neighboring published Pell 3/4 classification is different. No inspected primary result contains the exact 3/5 Pell index and Hilbert-family theorem.
residual_risks: An older unindexed Pell semigroup enumeration or equivalent recurrence specialization might cover this case.
No formulas are claimed for nonsymmetric-case Frobenius numbers and genera.
